HealthyLeaf.symptoms: Foliage displays natural green color without leaf spots, rusts, or lesions.
HealthyLeaf.cause: No pathogen detected. Normal plant physiological state.
HealthyLeaf.treatment: Continue regular irrigation, balanced soil fertilization, and monitoring.

BlackPoint.symptoms: Dark brown to black discoloration at the embryo end of the grain and foliage bases.
BlackPoint.cause: Fungal infection primarily caused by Alternaria alternata and Bipolaris sorokiniana.
BlackPoint.treatment: Use certified disease-free seeds and apply recommended fungicide seed treatments.

WheatBlast.symptoms: Bleached heads and dried leaves with dark gray spots.
WheatBlast.treatment: Apply triazole-based fungicides and utilize resistant cultivar seeds.

FusariumFootRot.symptoms: Brown discoloration of lower stems, crown rot, and stunted growth.
FusariumFootRot.cause: Fusarium culmorum fungal spores in soil.
FusariumFootRot.treatment: Ensure crop rotation with non-host crops and treat seeds with broad-spectrum fungicides.

LeafBlight.symptoms: Large brown oval spots on leaves that expand and cause leaf drying.
LeafBlight.treatment: Spray Mancozeb or Propiconazole at early onset of disease signs.

diseased cotton leaf.symptoms: Irregular reddish-brown lesions with yellowish borders across leaf tissue.
diseased cotton leaf.cause: Fungal pathogen attack exacerbated by humid weather.
diseased cotton leaf.treatment: Prune heavily infected lower leaves and apply copper oxychloride.

diseased cotton plant.symptoms: Widespread leaf yellowing, wilting, and brown necrosis patches.
diseased cotton plant.treatment: Spray recommended systemic fungicide and maintain proper field drainage.

fresh cotton leaf.symptoms: Bright green vibrant leaf structure without spots, lesions, or wilting.
fresh cotton leaf.treatment: Maintain optimal nitrogen levels and regular pest scouting.

fresh cotton plant.symptoms: Healthy vegetative canopy with clear green foliage.
fresh cotton plant.treatment: Follow standard irrigation schedule and crop care routine.

Pepper_bell___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, water-soaked spots on leaf surfaces turning brown with yellow halos.
Pepper_bell___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper-based fungicides and avoid overhead watering.

Pepper_bell___healthy.symptoms: Smooth green foliage free from spots or fungal powder.
Pepper_bell___healthy.treatment: Maintain standard soil moisture and plant nutrients.

Rice___Bacterial_leaf_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions turning yellow-white along leaf margins.
Rice___Bacterial_leaf_blight.cause: Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae bacterial pathogen.
Rice___Bacterial_leaf_blight.treatment: Apply copper-based bactericides and maintain proper field drainage.

Rice___Brown_spot.symptoms: Oval or sesame-shaped brown spots with yellow halos on leaves.
Rice___Brown_spot.treatment: Improve soil fertility with balanced NPK and apply Mancozeb fungicide.

Wheat___Yellow_rust.symptoms: Bright yellow pustules forming distinct linear stripes along leaf veins.
Wheat___Yellow_rust.cause: Puccinia striiformis fungal spores spread by air currents.
Wheat___Yellow_rust.treatment: Apply triazole-based fungicides like Propiconazole or Tebuconazole.

Mango___Anthracnose.symptoms: Dark brown to black angular leaf spots and blossom blight.
Mango___Anthracnose.treatment: Prune infected twigs and apply Copper Hydroxide or Carbendazim.

Citrus___canker.symptoms: Raised corky lesions on leaves and fruit with yellow water-soaked halos.
Citrus___canker.treatment: Apply copper spray during flush periods and remove infected twigs.
